design.nextId_derivation_reused_from_startNextS: manualSeriesContinuation(status, request, plan) + nextPartJobId(continuation) from bot/src/series.js — identical to lines 1462/1468 in bot/src/index.js

delete_flow_investigation.delete_removes_github_files_detail: bot/src/github.js deleteClipforgeJob (~line 1249) enumerates the recursive tree, filters entries whose path starts with 'jobs/<jobId>/', and deletes each blob via deleteRepositoryFile — both jobs/<nextId>/status.json and jobs/<nextId>/stage-a-request.json are removed from the default branch, and the release+tag are deleted. Since taskKeyboard's new check reads live from GitHub each render, the button naturally reappears on the previous part's card after the next part is deleted; no cached flag to invalidate.
